name: public-redis-expert-base
summary: Redis 知识基座：数据结构选型、Key 命名、连接池/Pipeline、集群/副本读取、TTL 与淘汰。供 devlab-middleware-expert 通过 extends 继承。借鉴自 redis/agent-skills。
runtime_requirements: This is a knowledge base skill, designed to be extended by other skills via the extends mechanism.
Pick the data structure that matches the access pattern, not just the shape of the data.
Use colon-separated key names with a stable hierarchy.
Always use connection pooling or multiplexing; never one connection per request.
